hero.title: Summer Courses in Denmark
hero.subtitle: Explore world-renowned public universities and leading research institutes in Denmark offering English-taught degrees, progressive problem-based learning, and modern Scandinavian campuses.

overview: Explore world-renowned public universities and leading research institutes in Denmark offering English-taught degrees, progressive problem-based learning, and modern Scandinavian campuses.
Studying in Denmark offers Indian students high-quality Scandinavian higher education with innovative problem-based learning, vibrant student cities, and excellent work-life balance.
Edu Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides Indian students through Optagelse.dk centralized admissions, Danish residence permits for study, document translation, and post-study establishment cards.

universities.name: University of Copenhagen (UCPH)
universities.desc: UCPH is Denmark's oldest and highest-ranking research university, celebrated across Scandinavia for medicine, life sciences, environmental law, and physics.

universities.name: Technical University of Denmark (DTU)
universities.desc: DTU is a leading European technical university renowned for sustainable energy, biotech engineering, wind turbine technology, and high startup spin-offs.

universities.name: Aarhus University
universities.desc: A globally top-100 public research university with an attractive yellow-brick park campus, acclaimed for business, computer science, and agricultural sciences.

universities.name: Copenhagen Business School (CBS)
universities.desc: One of Europe's largest triple-crown accredited business schools (EQUIS, AMBA, AACSB), leading in international management, finance, and green leadership.
